limitations: Alternative traction profiles preserve each original six-component wrench and byte-identical rigid inputs; local inadmissibility stays explicit. All seven FEM reference sweeps complete, with full fields separately archived. PCG release and absolute stopping-margin repair preserves the complete acceptance tolerances; original release failures, sampler/capacity and overly strict replay assertion failures remain exact. Native single-environment changing-contact fields and warmed scope are retained. Finer native sweeps, converged resolved egg/Franka and interior-hotspot contact, complete physical operating ranges and remaining traction maps are outside this checkpoint. JSON files above200MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original JSON exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
